capabilities: Automatically trigger query on file open
Overwrite old default query on settings update
intentEvidence: to simplify the process of inputting search queries in the backlinks view.
motivation: The author developed it to simplify the process of inputting search queries in the backlinks view and reduce clutter from daily notes.
problem: Manually inputting search queries in the backlinks view is cumbersome, especially when daily notes clutter the results.
summary: Sets a custom default search query for the backlinks panel, automatically triggering the query when a document is opened.
